_: Build tools, pinned by digest. A pack is only auditable if the tools that cut it are: `:latest` moves under the producer, and 'which pmtiles cut this archive' then has no answer. These are the exact images that built every published pack so far, so pinning changed nothing about the artifacts — it only made them nameable. The digest is what docker enforces; `tag` and `version` are here to be read. To upgrade: pull the new tag, record its RepoDigest (docker image inspect <tag> --format '{{index .RepoDigests 0}}'), and rebuild.
_valhalla: Must stay the version the server and the on-device engine run (infrastructure/valhalla/Dockerfile, apps/android): offline and online routing may not disagree on algorithms or data interpretation.
_planetiler: Cuts the master basemaps and the outdoor overlay (tiles/build-basemap.sh, build-outdoor.sh). Those archives are pack inputs, recorded per pack by size, mtime and digest — pinning the tiler is what makes rebuilding one of them reproducible rather than merely repeatable.
_cleanup: Only ever runs `rm -rf` over root-owned build leftovers the Valhalla container wrote through the work mount.
